items.item: Permanent reproducibility package and end-to-end rerun instructions
items.hypothesis_or_goal: A reviewer can follow each paper claim to public derived and raw artifacts and reproduce the declared offline analyses.
items.strengthens: all empirical claims and PVLDB artifact evaluation
items.missing_evidence: public permanence and environment/data acquisition instructions are not verified by the local checkout

items.item: Prospective Native ANALYZE stability study with direct NULL-state capture
items.hypothesis_or_goal: Independent native realizations preserve or change method rankings under a prospectively eligible payload contract.
items.missing_evidence: v1 captured six empty dependency payloads without an independent SQL-NULL marker

items.item: Production-exact truth acquisition and refresh-quality measurements
items.hypothesis_or_goal: The operational costs and maintenance implications of truth acquisition and refresh can be bounded in the intended deployment path.
items.missing_evidence: production-exact truth timing, refresh cost, and refresh quality trend
items.priority: optional; required only for stronger end-to-end cost claims

items.hypothesis_or_goal: Greedy ADD's quality benefit persists under a common measured resource vector rather than a configuration-count cap.
items.missing_evidence: current 300-second deadline is search-stage only and configuration evaluations are not uniform planner work
items.priority: optional; the cancelled 2,000-evaluation design is not recommended

items.hypothesis_or_goal: Lower cardinality-estimation q-error translates into improved selected-plan quality or query execution time under controlled workloads.
items.missing_evidence: current evidence measures EXPLAIN estimates and q-error, not execution latency
items.priority: optional; do not imply this claim in the current paper

items.item: Joins, multi-table workloads, and additional workload generators
items.hypothesis_or_goal: The snapshot, hypothetical payload, and recommendation workflow extends beyond the audited single-table simple-selection lineage.
items.missing_evidence: current benchmark and truth contract are primarily single-table and simple-selection

explicitly_not_recommended: Do not resurrect the historical fixed-evaluation-budget experiment solely as a 2,000-configuration cap; its fairness audit found that cap non-identifying without a shared resource model.
